entries.27c1c832da514dbc: It sells products in 7 categories (Health & Beauty, Paper Products, Pet, Household, Home Care, Household Goods and Others) to retailers nationwide. entries.69e8c9e2ce97efb0: The company’s management vision is “Creating beauty and health, and a clean and comfortable life.” The Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, with the fiscal year ended March 2026 as its final year, achieved net sales of ¥1 trillion, but left challenges in cost control and capital profitability; the company therefore formulated the final-phase Medium-Term Management Plan 2030. Its theme is “Refining strength, opening the future.” It positions the first half as a “strategic investment phase,” as it expects cost increases from growth investments to affect profit, and it aims to improve profitability toward the second half by strengthening the wholesale business and through growth strategies. Business strategies include expanding in-store share through strengthened distinctiveness, establishing new growth drivers, strengthening functions that support sales growth, and improving the profitability of group companies. It sets quantitative targets, including net sales for the fiscal year ending March 2030.

entries.ff60fd469de935e0: Sales are net sales from wholesale, selling products to retailers. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,004,749 million (up 1.9% year on year), renewing the record high for the 11th consecutive year and achieving ¥1 trillion, which had been the target for the fiscal year ending March 2030. The company cites as factors in the increase the growth of Health & Beauty and Pets, in addition to expanded sales of exclusive and priority distribution products and a rise in product unit prices due to the expansion of large-volume products and high value-added products. On the other hand, due to changes in consumer trends, sales volume did not grow, and it did not reach the target of ¥1.006 trillion.
